children: Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) reported approximately $46 billion in quarterly AWS revenue and $17.8 billion in AWS operating income.
Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) plans approximately $220 billion in capital expenditures this year, with spending expected to increase in 2027.
Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) said customer revenue commitments for its Graviton and Trainium custom chips each increased more than 20-fold year over year.
Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) said inference accounted for well over half of AWS AI revenue and plans to offer Trainium outside AWS starting in late 2027.
Amazon reported its $6.2 billion in Anthropic convertible notes had an estimated fair value of $146.2 billion at Sept. 30, up from $97.9 billion in June. Preferred stock was valued at $92.5 billion.
AWS launched Semarak AI Malaysia, a national program offering AI tools to government, businesses and communities, including plans to onboard 10,000 small businesses by 2028.
Freedom Broker maintained its Buy rating on Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) and raised its price target to $330 from $255.
Anthropic’s IPO filing says Amazon’s notes could convert into about 184 million shares of nonvoting preferred stock, subject to a 12% ownership cap Amazon may waive. Excess notes may convert later.
Amazon analyst views were mixed: Susquehanna held a Positive rating and $325 target, Evercore kept Outperform at $355, while Raymond James cut its target to $250 over cloud growth concerns.
Amazon (AMZN) faces potential delays to Texas data center projects as Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa seeks a pause pending rules on grid impacts, infrastructure costs, tax breaks and community input.
